stream_rule: For NC7 world w and development day index d in frozen day order, initialize the day's iid isotropic update-state RNG from numpy SeedSequence([20261001, w, d]) and generate only at that day's exact valid-L10 update timestamps. Each (world,day) stream is therefore deterministic and independent by construction.
scientific_reason: A null world spans all five development days. Day-specific child streams prevent accidental replication of the same Gaussian update sequence across days while preserving the preregistered base seed and 200-world identity.
